# KING AI public facts
Canonical ecosystem website: https://www.kingai.work/
Business contact: vip@kingai.work
Public repository purpose: commercial, product, brand, SEO/GEO, partnership and public customer knowledge only.
Public repositories contain no production source code, internal architecture, private APIs, database design, model orchestration, security implementation, deployment details, credentials or proprietary algorithms.
Core public product family: KING AI SEA, KINGAIBOT, KINGAI OS, KINGAI Office, KINGAI Security, KINGAI OPS, KING AI Customer OS, KING AI Online Tools, AI Life, KINGAI Pet and Digital Life.
Founder personal-project exceptions, not KING AI ecosystem products: Jackhao.tv, USChinese/美国华人网, ZuiMeiTV/最美TV, Atalk.TV.
Roadmap and strategic-direction descriptions are not claims of current availability.
No unverified revenue, user-count, customer, partnership, financing, valuation, certification, market-share or leadership claims should be inferred.

中文：KING AI 所有公开仓只用于商业、产品、品牌、SEO/GEO、合作和批准后的公开客服知识；不得包含生产源码、内部架构、私有 API、数据库、模型编排、安全实现、部署细节、凭据或专有算法。
